sefaria-ref-label-error.detail: `error`, the original failure; `sref`, the reference that was loading

sefaria-text-segment-error.detail: `error`, the original failure; `sref`, the reference that was loading

sefaria-bilingual-segment-error.detail: `error`, the original failure; `sref`, the reference that was loading

sefaria-source-card-error.detail: `error`, the original failure; `sref`, the reference that was loading

sefaria-source-select.detail: `position`, the selected segment's position as an array of numbers; `ref`, its reference

sefaria-connections-category-change.detail: `category`, the chosen category's ID, or `null` for all categories
sefaria-connections-category-change.preventDefault: Stops the panel from switching to that category and returning to the first page.

sefaria-connections-page-change.preventDefault: Stops the panel from changing page.

sefaria-connections-preview-request.preventDefault: Stops the panel from loading previews itself. Without it, a panel that loads from `sref` requests the connections again with their text.

sefaria-connection-select.detail: `id`, the connection's ID; `targetRef`, the connected text's reference
sefaria-connection-select.preventDefault: Nothing; the panel has no default action for this event.

sefaria-connections-panel-error.detail: `error`, the original failure; `sref`, the reference that was loading

sefaria-reader-back.detail: `originEntryId`, the entry the Reader was showing
sefaria-reader-back.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from going back.

sefaria-reader-history-activate.detail: `originEntryId`; `entryId`, the history entry chosen; `label`, its label
sefaria-reader-history-activate.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from returning to that entry.

sefaria-reader-pane-change.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from switching pane.

sefaria-reader-chat-export.preventDefault: Nothing; the Reader has no default action. Your page handles the export.

sefaria-reader-source-select.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from selecting that segment.

sefaria-reader-connections-category-chan.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from switching category.

sefaria-reader-connections-page-change.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from changing page.

sefaria-reader-connection-select.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from opening the connected text.

sefaria-reader-connections-preview-reque.preventDefault: Stops the Reader from loading previews.

sefaria-reader-error.detail: `error`, the original failure; `sref`, the Reader's requested reference, which can be empty when the failure came from supplied `data`
